requirements.label: LGCSE: six subjects, English and the general APS ceiling
requirements.details: The general bachelor's minimum is at least six LGCSE subjects: four at C or better including English Language, and the remaining two at D or better from the designated five subject groups. The Admission Points Score must not exceed 26. Faculty/route conditions also apply; the lower-is-better APS ceiling is not an IB Diploma total.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 6: General LGCSE entry

requirements.label: COSC: six passes and aggregate limit
requirements.details: For the COSC qualification route, the general bachelor's baseline is six passed subjects with four credits including English Language and two other passes, plus a First or Second Class pass with aggregate no greater than 34. This is a separate qualification route, not a requirement to hold COSC as well as LGCSE.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 6: General COSC entry

requirements.label: How the LGCSE APS is calculated
requirements.details: APS uses six recognized LGCSE subjects. The printed eight-point scale assigns A*=1 (90–100%), A=2 (80–89%), B=3 (70–79%), C=4 (60–69%), D=5 (50–59%), E=6 (40–49%), F=7 (30–39%) and G=8 (0–29%). Lower point totals are better. Do not treat 26 as a minimum score or convert it into an IB/AP total.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 6: APS calculation table

requirements.label: Two stamped academic references before consideration
requirements.details: Submit two academic references bearing official stamps of the referees' educational institutions. The reference should address academic aptitude, interests and character; the referee completes the comments and signs/dates the form. Applications are not considered until references have been received. The undergraduate reference form gives no 500-word applicant motivation-letter requirement.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 academic reference form, page 1

requirements.label: Certified identity document
requirements.details: Provide a certified passport, ID or other identification showing biographical information and expiry date.

requirements.label: Certified educational certificates and transcripts
requirements.details: Provide verified/certified educational certificates and transcripts; the prospectus excludes PSLE and Junior Certificate certificates from this requested set. Post-secondary qualification holders should include their applicable certificates/transcripts; no bachelor's degree is imposed on every school-leaver.

requirements.label: Application-fee payment evidence
requirements.details: Attach a copy of the application-fee payment confirmation. The fee-category wording differs between the prospectus and the separately linked undergraduate checklist, as recorded in the fee clarification; confirm the applicable category before paying.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 7: Requirements for applying

requirements.label: Fee categories: local/international versus SADC/non-SADC
requirements.details: The 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 7, gives M500 for local and M650 for international students. The undergraduate checklist currently linked from the 2026/2027 navigation instead labels M500 as SADC and M650 as non-SADC, while its actual file name says 2025–2026 and its body has no cycle. These classifications differ for some international applicants; no later effective date or automatic supersession is established. Verify the category and amount with Admissions.

source.title: NUL linked undergraduate checklist, page 1; file labelled 2025–2026

requirements.label: Foreign-qualification evaluation and the GCSE exception
requirements.details: The international-student paragraph requests ECOL evaluation/conversion of foreign transcripts/results and strongly advises doing it before applying. The application list specifically requests an ECOL certificate for matriculates but says foreign GCSE holders, for example LGCSE/IGCSE or equivalent, need not evaluate. The scope of that broad exception is not fully explained. Confirm the actual qualification's treatment; no IB/AP conversion or score is manufactured.

source.title: NUL 2026/2027 prospectus, printed page 7: International students and application item v

requirements.label: Agriculture and Science Education: English C versus D
requirements.details: The general LGCSE baseline requires English C, but the reviewed Agriculture school-leaver group and BSc with Education paragraphs print English D. Both statements remain applicable evidence; the prospectus does not expressly establish a general-rule waiver or precedence. Confirm the English threshold for the chosen route rather than treating faculty D as a guaranteed exemption from general C.

requirements.label: Agriculture and Agricultural Economics: school subjects
requirements.details: The Agriculture direct-entry group names BSc Agriculture and BSc Agricultural Economics. It requires at least six LGCSE/equivalent subjects: Mathematics C, English D, one of Biology/Physical Science/another recognized science at C, two other subjects at C and the remaining subject at D. Read with the shared English-C-versus-D clarification; this is not a published IB/AP subject-grade conversion.

requirements.label: Agriculture ranking and tie decisions
requirements.details: For the named Agriculture direct-entry group, ranking uses Mathematics, one science, and whichever is best of a second science, Agriculture or English. Ties use APS and/or another faculty admissions sub-committee criterion. These are ranking inputs, not a demand for all three optional third subjects, and meeting minima does not guarantee a place.

requirements.label: BEd and Special Education: shared school baseline
requirements.details: The Bachelor of Education and Bachelor of Education in Special Education direct routes require at least six LGCSE/equivalent subjects, four at C or better including English, and the remaining two at D or better. These conditions apply to the two named awards; Science Education and diploma-based Primary Education have separate entry routes.

requirements.label: BEd and Special Education: English teaching subject
requirements.details: Applicants intending to take English Language as a teaching subject in Bachelor of Education or Bachelor of Education in Special Education need English Language at B or better. This specialization-specific B requirement is separate from the shared general English-C school baseline.

requirements.label: Four direct Health Sciences degrees: merit ranking
requirements.details: For Nursing and Midwifery, Pharmacy (Honours), Environmental Health and Nutrition direct entry, ranking uses Mathematics, one recognized science and whichever is better of a second science or English. Ties use APS and/or another faculty admissions sub-committee criterion, and admission is on merit. This is not a promise of a place or three simultaneous optional-subject requirements.

requirements.label: Environmental Health and Nutrition: shared school subjects
requirements.details: The two named direct-entry degrees require at least six LGCSE/equivalent subjects: C or better in Mathematics, Biology/Physical Science/another recognized science, English and one other subject, with D or better in two remaining subjects. Nursing has a higher science grade and Pharmacy has a higher mathematics grade in their separate requirements.
